source.source_boundary: RELOP=REDUNDANCY enables traditional system k-out-of-n links. A single-item link uses its IID as RLID and needs no RedundancyLink row. A 1-of-2 ACTIVE group operates both installed links; one failed link does not itself fail the redundancy, while fewer than one functioning link makes its failures critical. ACTIVE ignores TSWOV. Link quantity NRL=2 must not exceed installed LRU QTYPM=2.

delta.mechanism: Preserve G01.var05's two installed LRU and nested SRU chains, stocks, repairs, tasks, seed and missions. Set reliability option to REDUNDANCY and place the two identical LRUs in one ACTIVE 1-of-2 single-item-link group.

predeclared_native_acceptance: Import/export preserves every author-populated row, including Control.RELOP and the Redundancy 1-of-2 row. Conversion errors are zero and nonempty valid event and report artifacts are emitted.

Two physical installed LRU links are represented. If exactly one link has failed and the other remains functioning, the system does not abort solely for that failure. If both links are failed concurrently, fewer than NRLRQ=1 remains and the system becomes nonfunctioning; its failures become critical.

Reconcile each observed link failure and repair with system and mission state, LRU/SRU stock demand and issue, repair timing, report intervals and terminal state. Do not infer a two-link-failed transition unless it occurs in the fixed-seed run.
Bind the frozen parent, input, contract, builder, checker, executable, invocation, closure and raw artifacts by SHA-256; use an independent read-only replay before publication.
limits: This first G10 scope covers a single-item ACTIVE 1-of-2 link group with the inherited two LRU/SRU chains and fixed seed. Two-item series links, PASSIVE switching, nonzero TSWOV, NRLRQ boundaries beyond this value and on-mission repair are unverified.
GUI-only behavior, stochastic generality and cross-engine equivalence are unverified.
